shared_elements: horizontal line or band dividing the field
schematic figure with limbs (anthropomorph or animal with legs)
round motif placed above other figures
justification: Both surfaces set a prominent round motif in the upper zone above smaller limbed figures, with straight horizontal lines/bands crossing the field and dividing it into registers, which is the most specific correspondence. Beyond that generic scheme they differ fundamentally: A is flat red pigment drawn in thin uniform lines on a rough grey rock face, with a single concentric-ringed anthropomorph, while B is three-dimensional carved relief on a shaped stone pillar densely populated with recognisable animals in profile, so the manner of making and the overall impression have little in common.
